correlationId.description: Safe correlation metadata only. Credential, token, borrower, customer, account, authorization, secret, and other protected values are redacted before emission.

cacheId.description: Safe cache identifier metadata only. Protected or credential-like values are redacted before emission.

cacheKey.description: Optional safe cache key label. Raw borrower/customer identifiers, credentials, tokens, secrets, authorization values, and oversized values are redacted before emission.

diagnostics.description: Diagnostics must be safe operational messages. Sensitive-looking or oversized free-form values are replaced with redaction diagnostics before emission.
